transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?
I guess... I just don’t care about things anymore. Art classes, board-game nights, hiking, soccer... I mostly just sit in my room and let everything go.
Have you lost interest in activities you used to enjoy, like art classes, board-game nights, or hiking?
Yeah. I mean… I used to do those things. Art class, board games, hiking… I even thought about getting back to soccer. Now I just don’t care. I mostly stay in my room and let it all go.
How long have you been feeling this way?
Since not long after my divorce… so, almost two years. I guess about a year and eleven months.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
Yeah… most days. I wake up and it’s just this heavy, empty feeling in my chest. Like there isn’t really anything past these apartment walls.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the contrary, have you been restless or fidgety lately?

Yeah… both, I guess. Some days I just pace back and forth, like from the kitchen to the window, until my legs hurt. Other times I’m so slowed down that even making coffee feels… too heavy. Like moving through wet cement.
Have you experienced episodes like this before, or has this been the only time you've felt this way since your divorce?
It’s… mostly been this one long stretch since the divorce. It started not too long after, and it’s been almost two years now. Maybe a year and eleven months.
Before this period starting after your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of time?
I… I don’t really know. I mean, I had bad weeks before, I guess, but nothing I can clearly point to like this. It’s hard to remember.
During this time since your divorce, have you had any periods where you felt somewhat better or noticed an improvement in your mood, even if it didn’t last?

Not really… not in any way that lasted. Most of the time it’s just been… heavy. Like I’m not just scared or mixed up, I’m depressed, and I don’t care about things anymore. Sometimes it feels like my life is already over.
Before this current period starting after your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of two weeks or more?
I’m not sure. I don’t really remember anything like that before this… not for two weeks or more, at least. Maybe I had rough patches, but I can’t say.
Before your divorce, was there ever a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for a period of two weeks or more that you can clearly remember?
Not before, no… not that I can clearly remember. It’s more now. Most days I wake up with this heavy, empty feeling, like there isn’t really anything past the apartment walls.
Before this current period after your divorce, have you ever had a major episode where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
No… I don’t think so. Not before the divorce. It’s really been now—most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling, like there’s no future past my apartment walls.
Before this current period after your divorce, have you ever experienced a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it wasn't connected to the divorce?
I don’t really think so. I mean… I can’t remember any time before this that went on that long.
Before this current period after your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it wasn’t as severe or long as this one?
No… not before this. It’s mainly now. Most days I wake up with this heavy, hollow feeling in my chest, like there’s nothing for me past the apartment walls.
Before your divorce, can you clearly remember any time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?
No… I can’t clearly remember anything like that before the divorce. If it happened, I don’t… I don’t think it lasted that long.
Before this current period after your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks that you would describe as a true depressive episode?
No… I wouldn’t call anything before this a real episode. I don’t remember it being like that.
Have you ever had periods where you felt unusually high, overly energetic, or irritable, where you didn’t need much sleep or felt like you could take on the world?
I don’t think so… not like taking on the world. I’ve had times I couldn’t sleep, but I wouldn’t say I felt high or full of energy.
Before this current period after your divorce, have you ever had a time when you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks, even if it wasn’t as severe as this one?
I don’t really remember a time like that before this. Maybe I had bad days, but… not more than two weeks, not that I can clearly say.
